next.reason: §1985:VII.3.4.2 is 'CODE-SET IS alphabet-name-1' alone. §2023:13.18.13.2 keeps that form but adds an optional alphabet-name-2 (a national alphabet) and the 'FOR ALPHANUMERIC' / 'FOR NATIONAL' phrases, and the sequential file description entry §2023:13.4.5.2 'Format 1 (sequential)' restates the same wider clause in line. A 1985 CODE-SET clause means the same, but programs the 1985 format refuses are accepted: CHANGED. The USAGE DISPLAY and SIGN SEPARATE restriction (§1985:VII.3.4.3 SR1, carried by §2023:13.18.13.3 SR3) is that rule's own record.
